_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The Lord is king; let the peoples tremble.
This is my Son; listen to him.
On the mountain his face shone like the sun.
This is my Son; listen to him.
It is good for us to be here.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Climb the mountain with them, into thin air and bright cloud, and watch his face begin to shine.
This is my Son, the Chosen; listen to him!
Moses and Elijah stand with him; the law and the prophets lean toward this one.
This is my Son, the Chosen; listen to him!
Peter wants to stay, to build, to hold the moment — but glory is not for keeping.
This is my Son, the Chosen; listen to him!
We come down changed, our own faces catching some of the light, sent back to the valley.
This is my Son, the Chosen; listen to him!
